header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH,
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Mr. Shoukat Ali Rahimoon advocate for the respondents No.6 & 7.
None present for the petitioners nor any intimation is received. The
body: petition was filed in the 2024 and lastly fixed on 04.11.2024. After notice, the comments were called wherein the respondent No.8 in comments has stated that District Administration, Mirpurkhas issued instructions in pursuance of directions of OGRA to the Assistant Commissioners/Civil Defence authority to take immediate action against illegal LPG shops if found. In view of such situation, the instant petition stands disposed of with directions to the Assistant Commissioner (s) concerned to act strictly in accordance with law and take action against all illegal shops of LPG. JUDGE JUDGE *Chander Kumar*
